novelty.identity: Reusable microbial capability reducing nematode egg hatching over a defined observation interval. Not the microorganism own development, a one-off assay row or sequence feature. Hatch reduction alone establishes neither egg death nor reversible arrest.
novelty.hierarchy: Phenotype METPO:1000059 below quality METPO:1000188. Current/pinned exact phenotype parent agrees. Pinned animal pathogen mentions infection; current animal-pathogen parent entails infectious disease/disorder. Neither is required by cell-free hatch inhibition. Existing feeding, trapping, lethal, attraction and paralysis traits are not exact or necessary parents.
novelty.ontology: Three explicit OWL inputs and six selected TSV owners, including deprecated/draft rows, yield only METPO:1007069 fried-egg-shaped colony and its annotations/stub. This morphological analogy is not a historical counterpart; no exact active/deprecated hatch class found in that scope. Editor conversion has 31 triples and no imports; failed initial parser/format attempts are retained as failures.
